Nark Posed As Student; Admits Lying To Them
And  "Passing notes asking the students if they could get her some pot."

From WTMJ-TV, Milwaukee, Wisconsin

COP POSED AS STUDENT

"They had no idea. No clue at all," the undercover officer said. But, four students at Wilmot High School now know all-too-well who the "new kid" was who showed up in class last February.

To classmates she was "Jayne Donovan" but she was really a 21-year-old undercover officer working for the Kenosha County Drug Unit. She still does not want us to use her real name or show her picture.

The officer told us, "It was very easy to find out who was smoking marijuana... Because they’d tell you... They’d make comment like I can’t wait until school’s out so we can go get stoned."

"Jayne" told us she would "act up" to get placed in "in-school suspension." There she met the targets of the investigation, over time developing relationships, eventually passing notes asking the students if they could get her some pot.

"And either they’d say yes or I know who does or I have it. And that’s how we’d go back and forth until we decided how we were going to do it."

In the end, "Jayne" said it wasn’t difficult turning on her pretend-peers and seeing four of them led away in handcuffs because they didn’t really know her at all.

"My name was a lie. The reason I was at the school was a lie. When they’d ask me ‘where do you live?’.. That obviously was a lie."

In the end, "Jayne" hopes the arrests will be a deterrent for others at Wilmot High. "I’m sure they’ll be a lot more careful with what they’re doing."

And she warned, "there’s a very good possibility another Jayne might come back."

Of the four students arrested Monday, one has been charged as an adult. The three others will face juvenile charges.

(Ed. note: The end is clearly seen as justifying the means. What did the students and their friends really learn?)
